verdict.rationale: Capacities is object-type-first. Users define custom object types with core properties, and templates can prefill properties, so properties stay consistent across notes. Tags are a first-class concept: AI assigns tags from your existing tags, graphs can be opened on a tag or query, and smart queries are listed as a feature. Community users praise its typed notes and its tags compared with Notion. Missing for 10: documentation of the available property data types, explicit docs on filtering or querying by property and tag values (smart queries are only named on the pricing page), and hands-on corroboration of retrieval workflows.
